name: ISO/IEC 27001 Implementation and Certification Assistance
metaDescription: Build an ISO/IEC 27001-aligned information security management system with gap assessment, risk, control, audit and certification-readiness support.

blocks.text: Build an Information Security Management System That Supports Trust and Growth
Cybersentinels Consulting helps organizations establish, implement
ISO/IEC 27001 defines requirements for establishing, implementing, maintaining
The engagement can include:
Organizational Context and Scope
Define interested parties, internal and external issues, ISMS boundaries, dependencies
Leadership and Governance
Establish policy direction, responsibilities, governance forums, objectives
Information Security Risk Management
Develop the risk methodology, identify and assess risks, select treatments
Statement of Applicability
Document Annex A control applicability, implementation status and justifications based on risk
Policies, Procedures and Controls
Develop or improve governance, operational and technical documentation aligned with implemented
Performance and Improvement
Establish monitoring, metrics, internal audit, management review, corrective action
Certification Readiness
Organize evidence, address outstanding gaps and coordinate readiness activities with the
1. Scoping and Discovery
Understand the organization, locations, services, systems, data, stakeholders
2. Gap Assessment
Evaluate current practices against ISO/IEC 27001 requirements
3. ISMS Planning
Define the implementation roadmap, responsibilities, governance cadence
4. Risk Assessment and Treatment
Perform information security risk assessment and establish treatment decisions
5. Documentation and Control Implementation
Develop required documentation and support operationalization across relevant functions
6. Awareness and Control-Owner Enablement
Help stakeholders understand responsibilities, evidence and recurring activities
7. Internal Audit and Management Review
Evaluate readiness, record findings and support management evaluation of the ISMS
8. Corrective Action and Certification Coordination
Address identified issues and support Stage 1
9. Ongoing Maintenance
Support risk reviews, internal audits, management reviews, metrics, evidence

blocks.text: Cybersentinels provides implementation and certification-readiness assistance
How long does ISO 27001 implementation take?
Duration depends on organizational size, scope, maturity, control gaps, stakeholder availability
Does ISO 27001 require every Annex A control?
No
Can Cybersentinels act as the certification body?
No
What happens after certification?
The ISMS must continue operating
